# The Vertical Adventurer (Archive)

> A historical archive of theverticaladventurer.com, a hiking, climbing, canyoning and van-life blog covering New Zealand and Australia, active roughly 2017-2022. Content was recovered from the Internet Archive Wayback Machine and is preserved as-is for historical reference; it is not an active or maintained blog.
